content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-43. - Jurors' fees.
content.summary:
Jurors shall receive for appearing before the municipal court $6.00 per day, or $12.00
               per day if chosen to sit on a jury, to be paid out of the general funds of the city.
(Code 1960, § 1-15; Code 1981, § 18-31; Ord. No. 2487, § 1, 2-15-1988; Ord. No. 3420,
               § 1, 11-17-1…
